answer.reason: The December 2024 private-sector covered employment figure for Texas NAICS 23 Construction was 876,336 jobs; the larger 1,059,491 figure corresponds to the total construction figure rather than private-sector only.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Texas, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 23 Construction?

A. 876,336 covered jobs
B. 1,059,491 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Texas statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/48000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: A
